== Summary ==
Roxanne Barbour and Nikki Frederich square off in Game 1 of Star Trek CCG Wild Card. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
